name: When I Rule The World
source:
"My name is Selena, and I have been chosen to be the future ruler of the world." She might look like an ordinary schoolgirl, but a secret organisation called The Agency are going to overthrow the world and institute her as ruler of the new world order!

[From [url=http://www.toothycat.net/~hologram/WhenIRuleTheWorld/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
“我叫Selena，我被选中成为未来的世界统治者。”她或许看起来只是一名普通女学生，但一个名为“The Agency”的秘密组织即将推翻现有世界，让她成为新世界秩序的统治者！

[摘自[url=http://www.toothycat.net/~hologram/WhenIRuleTheWorld/]官方网站[/url]]
